summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET web page designed to welcome and manage the staff administration interface, incorporating web controls and AJAX features.
purpose: To provide an interactive and feature-rich interface for staff administrators, complete with data entry fields, validators, and dynamic controls.

workflows.name: Staff Administration View Refresh
steps: Select site and discipline from dropdowns.
Enter start and end dates for data filtering.
Click refresh to update the displayed information.

validations.name: StartDate Required
validations.description: Ensures that a start date is entered.

validations.name: EndDate Required
validations.description: Ensures that an end date is entered.

validations.name: EndDate After StartDate
validations.description: Ensures the end date is later than the start date.

system_behavior: Handles date input and validation for start and end dates.
Allows toggling of withdrawn applications visibility.
Utilizes AJAX and ASP.NET controls for dynamic interface features.
